run_local_llama_inference: run local Llama model inference with a prompt file and safety checks
run_gradio_llama_playground: launch a gradio web UI for interactive Llama model inference
run_llama_inference_with_quantization: run Llama model inference with 4bit or 8bit quantization enabled
run_llama_inference_with_peft: run Llama model inference with a PEFT adapter model loaded
run_llama_inference_with_safety: run Llama model inference with Azure, Salesforce, or LlamaGuard content safety checks
